symptom: Weeping at flange joint after valve replacement.

probable_causes.cause: gasket not replaced or wrong thickness

procedures: 2. break joint; inspect faces; replace gasket ALWAYS
3. clean faces; no old gasket fragments
4. finger-tight all bolts, then torque in cross sequence in 3 steps
5. torque values from a human-verified table - agent must not invent them
verification: pressure test per site procedure before returning to service
safety_notes: line contents may be hazardous; verify zero energy before breaking joint
